facts.fact: INTIC's second zero draft of the National Data Governance Policy and Implementation Strategy is a Council of Ministers resolution with its number and approval date left blank, so not adopted; the date is a proxy from the November 2025 upload folder, the document carrying none.
facts.system: National Data Governance Policy and Implementation Strategy (Zero Draft 2)

note: The draft would establish a National Data Governance Council and name draft NDGC standards, but a draft's planned body and rules are not a body named or a rule issued.
